name: makarasty
description: Fleet tooling for Claude Code: run one mission across several sessions, each gating what it can actually see, all reporting through files.

plugins.name: makarasty
plugins.description: Split a mission across worker sessions, then gate what they change: a fix is refused without a reproduction that failed before it, a cause several findings share is ruled on once before any of them is patched, and an edit that drops a name something outside the repository reads is blocked until a question or a recorded decision names it. Ten mission kinds, gated browser checks, per stage model selection, file based reporting.

plugins.name: makarasty-tools
plugins.description: Commit under your own name, review a diff with evidence, strip assistant tics out of writing, say what you mean in simple English for a call or a vendor, and get a Telegram, Discord or ntfy message when a chat or a fleet run finishes. Versioned apart from the fleet.
